why: The inkpot, spectacles and quill already say careful study, and an underlining pet suits a guardian who checks what the paper actually says.

veto.quote: decorative science; a wrong name or year
veto.why: An icon is seen before any paper is opened, so a pet there would claim a method that nothing on screen shows.

style: Every pet is drawn in plain, legible ink and underlines only what its source really says.
making: Codex may draw props or marks the charter never mentioned; the review should check each pet against its guardian's text, not only its look.
